[KTB Colour] 8/25 — MPC D-2

▪ Technicals — 4h momentum has turned. TRIX through its signal line; MACD still converging on zero, confirmation pending.

▪ Positioning — locally a hike, not a hold, is the dominant view, yet the book does not look heavy. IRS and futures flow point the other way, with offshore long: +13,423 contracts in 3Y futures on 08-24, cumulative 126,435 against a 6-month high of 131,180.

▪ Oil — the swing factor. Not a chart that argues for breaking higher from here. Continued downside keeps the bond long alive.

▪ Level — on a rally, first objective in 3Y futures is 103.76, filling the 4/23 gap. Unfilled since.

▪ MPC — the hike itself and the headcount at 3.50 both matter. But with the debasement trade leaving US traders' delta lighter than assumed, the sell-off may prove shallower than feared.

▪ Bottom line — if the rally comes, KTB outperforms the US. US–KR 10Y wider.
